title: Peer-Reviewed Agent Method Phylogeny
purpose: Maintain a continuously expanding, peer-reviewed, high-quality development tree of agent methods. Every promoted node must be reproduced natively downstream and used to pressure-test Noetrium from method semantics through benchmark, experiment, metrics and evidence.

scope_rule.core: Only peer-reviewed conference/journal publications admitted by research/catalog/publication_quality_policy.json may enter this formal phylogeny.
scope_rule.satellite: Application descendants are included when they introduce a distinct transferable mechanism or a materially different experimental regime.
scope_rule.completeness: Continuously audit top venue proceedings and citation neighborhoods; missing high-quality mechanism nodes are added rather than silently skipped.
scope_rule.reproduction_unit: Publication version + exact source cut + benchmark/environment/data cut + MethodProgram + Study/Experiment + measurements + baselines + ablations/statistics needed for the paper claim + immutable evidence.

platform_rule.promotion_gate: A mechanism moves upstream only after multiple independent peer-reviewed reproductions demonstrate method-independent semantics.

execution_protocol: Verify peer-reviewed venue identity before promotion into the formal graph.
Freeze the exact publication version and paper-era source cut before implementation.
Implement method semantics natively under research/reproductions without importing project runtimes into platform architecture.
Bind every method to at least one immutable benchmark/environment/data cut before protocol-bound status.
Implement Study/Experiment, measurements, paper baselines, ablations and statistics required for the published claim.
Run structural fidelity tests, deterministic/source-cut smokes, pilot experiments and matched experiments.
Record platform friction and only promote abstractions after repeated independent pressure.
